notes.title: HARD MODE & NEW GAME+ Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/73f06f84946a909ee3efc20e01cae7f4e0be1f2d.png[/img]

Hello, we are KIWIWALKS!
We are excited to introduce Version 1.301 and its additions of Hard Mode and NG+.

Read further for more details!

[b][h2]<1.301 Update Notes>[/h2][/b]
1. New difficulty levels added - Hard/Very Hard
- The patterns of boss and semi-boss enemies are changed.
- Some player skills are rebalanced for these difficulties only.

[h3]2. New Game Plus Mode (NG+)[/h3]
1) Can be started via "New Story" on the title screen
2) If you have a record of viewing the ending, you can use any save file to start again from Chapter 1.
- The initial tutorial story will be skipped and you will start in the middle of Chapter 1.
3) New content exclusive to NG+ mode
- New monsters
- New equipment

[h3]3. Quality of Life Features[/h3]
1) Auto-skip Dialog
- Added an option to automatically skip dialog once voiced lines end.
2) Crafting Mastery
- Once you craft a healing potion/combat tool 3 times, you will get double the amount of crafting experience in subsequent crafts.

[h3]4. Skill Balancing[/h3]
1) Increased efficiency of HP-consuming skills
- Each time you use a skill that consumes HP, its power is increased by 36%. Combining skills with this effect will increase the power of all of them.
- Applies to: Overload Strike 1, Overload Strike 2, Ultimate Strike, Ecarr Vertel, Ecarr Half
2) Life Staff
- HP recovery amount from skills can now be amplified with Strategic CRIT.
- Excess recovery amount from skills is capped at 65% of max HP.
3) Pet Balancing
- Lucca: The number of cooldown turns required when using Turn Pass has been changed.
Changed from 1 turn on first use and 4 turns subsequently to 3 turns on first use and 3 turns subsequently.
- Aslan: Increased power of secondary skill.
4) Added more defense skills on top of Basic Defense
- Charge Strength (from Physical Training Stage 2)
- Charge Magic (from Mental Training Stage 2)

[h3]5. Hard/Very Hard Mode-Exclusive Balancing [/h3]

notes.title: [Game Release Notes] It's finally the release date!
notes.content:
Hello, this is Kiwiwalks! 

Today is finally THE day! 
It has been nearly a month since our last note, we have made improvements, added a bit more content, and fine-tuned various aspects of the game.

As we have already covered most gameplay systems in previous dev notes, we won't dive into the specifics again.

Apart from the growth/progression system that most[i] WitchSpring[/i] fans are already familiar with, [b][i]WitchSpring R[/i][/b] features a more strategic (and sometimes tactical) battle system. We hope this will reduce the monotony of repetitive battles, allowing players to enjoy winning battles through various mixes and matches. And for those who may find it challenging, there is a "simple" difficulty level available in the settings menu, which should make everything much easier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/2fa6e5a1c4da754a0f368f3a8d1e9ee5a8636aef.png[/img]

In addition, we would like to update the inaccurate description in the last notes. After observing the game process of some experienced players, we found that the completion time of the main story should be around 22-25 hours; and there are 20 types of pets/monsters that can be capture, while you will also meet companions who can go on adventures together, and assist in battles.

Regarding the story, we have introduced some new charming characters in [i]WitchSpring R[/i]. Their presence has greatly improved the richness of the game story and the overall worldview. Furthermore, these characters have unique side-quests that you can discover, and completing them will unlock hidden story scenes at the end of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/e2f5442a8ffbe4cb5ffbdcca9847ef6edda2b685.png[/img]

In response to player feedback, we have made several adjustments to the game's audio, and display, and tested the device performance, and compatibility. Players have mentioned issues with the SFX and music volume ratio, which can now be adjusted separately. The game is also compatible with older operating systems such as WIN 7 and 8, but we still strongly recommend playing the game with the minimum requirements stated on the store page. If you experience frame drops or freezes, you can try adjusting the game's image quality,  which could help to improve performance. If you encounter any compatibility issues, please email our customer service team. They will respond asap to help resolve the issue.

[i]WitchSpring R[/i] is Kiwiwalks' first PC and console game. We chose Pieberry as the protagonist because her story serves as the basis for the entire [i]WitchSpring[/i] story. Pieberry is a kind and adorable little witch who never gives up, we hope you will enjoy embarking on this adventure with her.

Now the game can run perfectly on Steamdeck, we hope it could be a temporary "substitute" for players who like to play games on handheld devices.   

After the game's release, we plan to take a short break and then prepare the game's soundtrack and additional costumes as paid DLC. Please look forward to the DLC release!

Finally, if you enjoy playing the game, we would sincerely appreciate it if you could leave a positive review in the store. This will greatly assist us. We also welcome you to join our Discord server or follow our official Twitter account to stay up-to-date with community events. If you encounter any issues while playing the game, please feel free to contact our customer service email (wsr@pixmain.com) at any time.

Thank you and have fun!

notes.title: [Dev Log] Current Progress
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. It's been a long time since my last "hello"!

We actually wanted to share the development progress with you all more often on Steam, but this got delayed as we have limited manpower (3 people in the whole team now), and we wanted to share more content at a time. 

It's been three months since we released the first demo, and we've received much feedback and supportive play reviews about the game (Thank you!!). Much appreciate every message that was sent to us, and we are sorry that we were too busy and unable to reply to each of them. 

The game development of WitchSpring R, which has been going on for a long period of two and a half years, has now been completed by more than 90%. The main story, environment, characters, items, systems, and other important parts have all been completed.

Now we are polishing the overall details of the game, and please allow me to share some of them with you in the last part of this note.

[b]<About recent development progress>[/b]

We are currently in the process of refining each chapter.

1) Related to UI / UX optimization
We've been focusing on UI / UX optimization for the past few months. We hope that everyone can feel that we've done our best when they see the official release version of the game. (We've received feedback on PlayX4 from players who played the first demo, saying the UI / UX has become more convenient and refined! ♥）

2) Related to localization and voice dubbing.
We have started to work on the localization of the whole story since last month. This title is expected to have about 250,000 words in Korean, so the localization and QA work alone will take at least one month. After the translation. We have to work on Korean and Japanese dubbing, so there are a lot of things to be prepared. This time we are working with a more professional new agency, hoping that we could present the game with better localization quality. 

3) Related to adding platforms.
We are currently evaluating the work of porting the game to various console platforms and hoping to release the game on other console platforms soon after the PC release. One thing to mention is that we've recently run the latest version of the build on Steam Deck and found it very satisfying overall! For those who are looking forward to playing WitchSpring R on Steam Deck, I hope it is a little bit of good news.

4) Others
Finally, I'd like to share a little spoiler with you. If you look at the recent PlayX4 booth design in Korea, there are new characters that have appeared. Have you noticed? That's right. In this title, there are several new characters that did not exist in the mobile version of "WitchSprings"!  WitchSpring R is the first PC title developed by KIWIWALK with new stories, new characters, and new systems. If you are curious about the information about the new characters, please keep an eye on DevNote updates in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/b53134509143d67a15be14b0d82b8e9bd9f0d4f8.png[/img]

Next, I really wanted to show you！

[b]<Introducing the new game system and improvement of WitchSpring R>[/b]

[previewyoutube=KAwQpId8Sew;full][/previewyoutube]

1) New World Map
We have a new world map with multiple new features!

2) Teleportation via World Map
Now you can use the teleportation function directly on the world map. You can always move around the area conveniently if you are in a place where you can use teleportation!

3) New adventures with specific pets
With the help of specific pets, you can carve out new routes that can not be traveled on foot.

4) Improved dialogue UI 
The screen where you can read past conversations has been redesigned, and now you can play the dialogue with voiceover too.

5) Improvement of the hunting function
You can hunt while riding a pet now! 

6) Addind quick combat function
There is no need to bother with battles that end in overwhelming victories, allowing for faster game progress.

7) Quicker Turns
When the same monsters fight in the same pattern, they will take action at the same time!

8) Added the ability to have Black Joe run errands
Now Pieberry can have Black Joe run errands while she sleeps!


Besides what has been introduced, we've developed many more elements that make the game more playable, as WitchSpring R will have a lot of areas and content to explore. You can check the videos for more new content that has not been mentioned. Though there are still many things I want to share with you, it is better for you to discover them through your own gameplay in the future, right? ;)

Finally, about the release date and related plans...
We will share it with you again in the near future, so stay tuned!:)

notes.title: 【Dev Log】 Recent progress & Release Info update
notes.content:
Hi guys! This is Suyoung, the producer of WitchSpring R. It's been a while since our last Dev Log, but we've made good progress on a playable build of WitchSpring R since then. 

In the meantime, I will try my best to keep WitchSpring fans updated with what we're working on now, so the frequency of future Dev Logs will increase to once per month!

We are currently still focusing on game production and have recently finished:
1. The main setting of the game, world view, main character design (check the details here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1958220/view/3458229997600763926)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/e53a2f7d875b431af4bcbc8a044b96fe48fd8781.png[/img]
2. Map and monster design
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/a943633496da8b974f35c330ad9becf8b561647a.png[/img]
3. The main gameplay & mini-game system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/c412d139b9f0fc713d740a78a0d06fe71d17bc00.png[/img]


For the rest of 2022, we will be working on:
1. Improving 2D illustration and adding 3D art
2. Sound related work
3. Tweaking game balance and other game content work
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/db2da19a3d92d43ae8e7ea36bd39fd51a3ce304a.png[/img]

Since we want to make WitchSpring R as perfect as we can, we've gone deep into detail on each part of the development process, causing us to re-evaluate our release timeline. 

Our new timeline targets a 2023 release. By December 2022, we will finish the basic game dev. In the following months, we will focus on the voiceover, quality assurance, soundtrack, and other polish. 

If I had developed and published the game by myself, I would have completed development and released the game in a similar timeframe as I have before . However, now I'm hoping to show WitchSpring R to everyone in a more complete form with the help of a publisher, so we'll need a little more time for the official release.

With the development process coming to an end, this decision was also very difficult for us. This is the first time KIWIWALKS has created a game for PC / console from scratch. It was not just simple porting work, but a decision to create a completely new WitchSpring R. We apologize to everyone for the change in the scheduled release time.

A playable demo will be released in Spring 2023, and we are so excited for you to experience the demo of WitchSpring R soon! We can not wait to share it with more people. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/3ae99015c8200e84fbbe1ead0cf90fc8807a8a28.png[/img]

Oh, and I heard from the publishing team that today is Thanksgiving day. We hope this Dev Log finds you all well, and we want to express our deep appreciation to all the players who support us! Thank you for your warm words and future support. See you again soon!

notes.title: [Development Note] A Story that Begins Again
notes.content:
[h2]
[i][b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/cec7142ae4699437a56d4f08a7de034c00f4e4a5.png[/img]

A world where all deities disappeared. [/b][/i][/h2]

Humans, after coming to the realization that
their desire to take over the deities' power is impossible,
decide to instead erase all traces of the deities from the world.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/eca62b_1aebe95d411f4c8ba891c7bb1932d31f~mv2.gif[/img]

Not only did they destroy the altars 
with their own hands,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/b88d8db20d6b7469da20981cc67ac6c715e898f7.png[/img]

[b][i]but they also labeled
those who dealt magical powers a 'Witch', and
begun to hunt them mercilessly.[/i]
[/b]




And here,
we see a 'witch' living on her own, away from the eyes of humans. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/c358b01db88bd58317d0766a7dbb0cdbc0f8aaab.png[/img]

This small yet energetic witch is called[b] 'Pieberry'. [/b]




On a towering cliff, in a small forest surrounded by the sea,
lives Pieberry alone. 

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/eca62b_08637020f8f844059460b35ff2b11233~mv2.gif[/img]

With no friends and no family. 


[h3]
[i][b]The witch's wish is to get out of the forest, even just once.[/b][/i][/h3]


But the only path to get out of the jungle
is blocked by a huge golem called 'Balt'. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/4626b0964464e162b2348866a22aeaee98c791cd.png[/img]



The witch goes on adventures, fights monsters,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/24d0d5aea37f0aac4ba34f8e8d8c59433b94c7e8.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/69cd565ed39d3c72e9a1de91f215f21895a2559b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/7129e618340066b9f58999a2b2d62c48c5c02b7f.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/b3cc39069863245a3c946de7ab5f51c0515ce509.gif[/img]

crafts tools using the magical materials collected outside,
and even trains to grow stronger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/dbd429aa53aa8293d3ea03644a874e557b7c2eac.png[/img]

All of these efforts are for the sake of beating Balt, and getting out of the forest one day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/5f6dd6a456e9b8ecdf6260c4cdcac024f5862b55.gif[/img]

But this is never an easy job. 




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/a58156aeed7d71b0b4cfbc0b3c114ca50b32b865.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/a42cdb151a263f58ccd0f7d2c3e80846254c7065.gif[/img]

At the end of all kinds of hardships,
sits a world outside!




Only to see what awaits her is...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/206f8dacd7465ae3d7dc74a682af2dcbe8f71497.png[/img]

How come everybody is bullying her? 

Now, the stories surrounding Pieberry will begin to unfold. 



--------------------------------------------------------



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42443136/0a9372f645588896940c7ee7b92c553b66ba83a3.png[/img]

Hi everyone, this is Kiwi Walks!  🤗🤗

This is a story of a witch who is chased after by warriors. 
Now we are going to introduce the story of <WitchSpring R> on the development note.


We will also show the voting results regarding "What I'm curious about WitchSpring R",
which was conducted on social media around the world.
Check out the voting results from different social media channels!

No.1: Characters
No.2: Growth System
No.3: World View
No.4: Map/Regions
No.3: Battle System
No.3: Pet System

According to the voting results,
we will first begin with the introduction of characters, growth systems, and world view, which are deemed to be mostly interested by many of you.
So stay tuned!


Due to the limited manpower of our development team, 
it hasn't been the easiest for us to deliver new updates as it requires many tasks such as video editing and language translation.

Although our biggest goal is to create high-quality games, therefore prioritizing game development over publicity,
we do feel deeply sorry and greatful for all our users who have been nothing but patient.
Regardless, we will strive to get well-prepared as soon as possible and to deliver you more new updates. 

To showcase the most advanced game systems and graphics in the history of the series,
we are doing our very best to introduce completely new scripts and characters.
We ask that you continue to support us! 😊
